title: Choose design directions
responsibility: Returns distinct predefined directions for visual design options in their established order.

inputs.name: designDirections.count
inputs.description: The end index passed to `slice` for the fixed list of ten directions, determining how many leading directions are returned. This matters when selecting the number of options; the function performs no validation, so JavaScript `slice` index conversion and negative-index behavior apply, and values above ten can return only ten.

outputs.name: designDirections
outputs.description: A new string array containing directions from the fixed, ordered list, starting with the plainest reading of the proposal. It matters when presenting design options; the list has ten entries, so large counts cannot return more than ten, while other values follow JavaScript `slice` end-index behavior.
examples: Follow the proposal most directly, as its plainest reading.
Show more at once: a dense, information-first layout.
